action: Written preservation representation identifying date, location and time window, requesting that control-room logs, wireless logs, CCTV and any body-worn footage be preserved pending disposal of an RTI application.
authority: SSP Patna; SP Katihar; SP Munger. Three separate representations.
method: Speed post to each office, retaining proof of despatch.
legal_basis: Not a statutory instrument. A representation puts the authority on notice; destruction after notice is itself a documentable fact.
notes: MOST URGENT ITEM. No court is seized of the Bihar incidents. Nothing currently interrupts any retention schedule.

action: RTI seeking the record retention schedule itself, separately from any substantive request.
method: jaankari.bihar.gov.in where the office is enrolled, otherwise post.
notes: The schedule is a record. This converts an assumption into a citable fact, and may reveal more time than feared.

action: RTI seeking the 'SOP in place' referred to in the Delhi High Court's preservation direction.
authority: Delhi Police via the Ministry of Home Affairs.
notes: The order refers to it; the archive should hold it.

action: Retrieve the Delhi High Court order in W.P.(CRL.) 2127/2026 from the court's own site.
notes: Everything currently held on this proceeding is secondary reporting.

action: Retrieve s.4(1)(b) proactive disclosure manuals for every authority in the document custody category, to establish PIO designations.
authority: Delhi Police; MHA; Bihar Police; district administrations of Patna, Katihar, Munger.
method: Each authority's own website. No application needed.
legal_basis: s.4(1)(b) RTI Act, which requires publication.
notes: Unblocks the entire custody section. Do nothing else in that section until this is done.

action: RTI for the general diary entry at Parliament Street police station for 20 July 2026, naming the station, the date and the recorded fact.
notes: Well-targeted because the entry is already publicly referenced, though only via a tertiary source. Trace the underlying citation first.

action: Application to inspect, or for a certified copy of, the State's counter affidavit in W.P.(CRL.) 2127/2026.
method: Registry, through an advocate on record or by application.
cost: Per-page certified copy fee, UNKNOWN pending OQ-018
notes: TIMING: the affidavit was due four weeks from the late-July order, so late August. The matter is listed 11 September. File between those dates.

action: HRCNet public complaint search for the NHRC suo motu proceeding and the Vashisht complaint, to obtain diary or case numbers.
notes: Gives the archive a citable handle for a pending case.

action: Retrieve FIRs for the Patna, Katihar and Munger incidents.
legal_basis: Published under Supreme Court and High Court orders per the SCRB's own statement.
notes: Portal copies are REPORTED, not VERIFIED. Certified copies must come from the district or unit. Search multiple transliterations.

action: RTI to each District Magistrate asking whether a magisterial inquiry was ordered, and if so for the order and findings.
authority: DM Patna; DM Katihar; DM Munger; and the Delhi equivalent once OQ-006 resolves.
method: Jaankari or post for Bihar; rtionline.gov.in for Delhi.
notes: Do not presume an inquiry exists. A negative answer is a finding worth recording.

action: RTI for deployment orders, force requisitions under BNSS s.149, and any written authorisation by the District Magistrate of another Executive Magistrate.
method: Per jurisdiction. Maharashtra applications must be split one subject per application, 150 words.
notes: BNSS s.149 as amended requires a named office acting on written authorisation. That authorisation is a discrete document. Ask for it by name.

action: Table a legislature question through a sitting member.
authority: Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha for Delhi; Bihar Vidhan Sabha for Bihar.
method: Through a member. Procedure per each House's Rules of Procedure.
notes: No citizenship gate, so this route stays open in all four filer scenarios. The Bihar Assembly is already seized of the subject. Blocked on OQ-023.

action: Retrieve an authoritative text of the Right to Information Act 2005 and record the URL actually fetched, to restore RTI-ACT-001 and RTI-ACT-002 to VERIFIED.
authority: India Code. If India Code cannot serve the Act, the alternative official publisher is UNKNOWN and becomes an open question rather than a guess.
method: indiacode.nic.in, navigating from its Central Acts listing. Do not reconstruct a bitstream path by editing the one that failed.
legal_basis: Published primary legislation. Not an application.
notes: SEQUENCE 0 so this precedes FQ-001 without renumbering the queue. Every deadline in this queue is computed from RTI Act timelines that are currently UNVERIFIED: s.7(1) thirty days, the s.7(1) proviso forty-eight hours, s.7(7) with s.11 forty days, the s.5(2) proviso thirty-five days, s.19(1) and s.19(3) appeal windows, and s.7(2) deemed refusal. The previously recorded URL https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/2013/1/A2005-22.pdf was fetched on 16 August 2026 and returned HTTP 302 to a page titled 'India Code: Invalid URL or Argument(s)' containing no text of the Act. That failure is itself recorded rather than papered over. Free, needs no application, and blocks nothing while it is done.
